programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang "Raya Emas" telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.(n)

programme.title: Janin Iblis Neraka
programme.desc: Sepasang suami isteri, Dika (Samuel Rizal) dan Ranti (Aliyah Faizah), tinggal di rumah baharu. Kekacauan dalam kehidupan pasangan itu mula muncul apabila Ranti mengandung dan anak yang dikandungnya adalah janin syaitan.(n)

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak

programme.title: Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orang-orang kecil kelas bawahan di FlatSimpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan,bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak. Mereka jugaberhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antaramereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orangpenghuni flat tersebut.(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S4 EP10
programme.desc: Robyn McCall dijadikan tebusan oleh Salazar dan pasukannya. Keadaan ini memaksa Harry dan Mel berlumba dengan masa untuk menyelamatkan Robyn, yang akhirnya berjaya menamatkan tindakan Salazar.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP1
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu di sebuah Kg Kuala Pari Hilir. Tiga kanak-kanak bersahabat iaitu Yeh Kumbang, Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi perlu melintasi rumah Wan Peah selepas mengaji Quran. Wan Peah dikatakan seorang yang misteri, tinggal sendirian, mengamal ilmu hitam dan sering mengganggu kanak-kanak ini. Tok Hashim sebagai ketua kampung mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Faan yang selalu bermain dengan Yeh, Gani dan Li. Suatu hari semasa bermain menyorok berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah, Faan dia telah dibawa lari oleh Wan Peah masuk ke rumahnya.(n)

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP14
programme.desc: Adam menyiasat kes kehilangan Nora. Suspek utama ialah Dr Zahir berdasarkan mimpi Alia.Dr Flora mengizinkan Alia dan Susan membawa Adam ke rumah Dr Zahir. Mereka pelik melihat Dr Zahir pulang bersama Sophie.Mereka menyelinap masuk dan mengesyaki sesuatu. Nyawa Sophie terancam apabila terjumpa mayat mangsa-mangsa Zahir dalam sebuah bilik. Berlaku perselisihan antara mereka yang jelas didengar oleh Adam,Alia dan Susan. Perselisihan itu menyebabkan Sophie dibunuh. Rahsia dia mengupah Dr Zakir untuk membunuh Alia dan Kai turut terbongkar.Dr Zahir dapat menghidu kehadiran Alia dan Susan. Dalam situasi berasingan Ritz didera dan diancam bunuh oleh seorang lelaki bertopeng.(n)

programme.title: 13 Exorcisms
programme.desc: Sebuah filem yang diilhamkan oleh beberapa kes eksorsisme yang berdaftar di Sepanyol. Laura ialah seorang gadis berumur 16 tahun yang ditekan oleh persekitarannya dengan ibu bapanya ialah Tomás, seorang lelaki lemah lembut tanpa watak, dan Carmen, seorang fanatik Katolik yang percaya kepada Tuhan yang menghukum dan yang sentiasa menekan Laura serta abangnya Jesús untuk terus berdoa.(n)

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP1
programme.desc: Pengantara Saiful Azmi Jamsari berkongsi pengalaman semasa merakamkan beberapa episod Detik 12 Malam sebelum ini. Antaranya Episod 1 Musim 1 bertajuk Kisah Penggali Kubur. Beliau terlihat asap berkepul-kelul semasa menggali kubur semasa rakaman. Episod 2 Musim 2, Bertajuk Pemandu Kenderaan Jenazah. Pengantara memandu sendiri van tersebut dan dilihat kain meliput jenazah diterbalikkan. Episod 12 Musim1, Petugas Bilik Mayat. Pengantara berkongsi pengalaman apabila melihat kemunculan lembaga. Episod 9 Musim 2, bertajuk Muzium Perang. Pengantara ternampak patung dalam muzium perang tibatiba- tiba seakan-akan kepalanya bergerak. Episod 3 Musim 1, bertajuk Renjer Hutan. Beliau bertugas sebagai renjer hutan, diganggu oleh saka masyarakat orang asli. Pengantara melihat sendiri makhluk halus melalui kawasan tersebut.(n)

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Subuh (L)
programme.desc: Program bual bicara keagamaan mengupas topik berkaitan dengan menghidupkan ibadah di waktu Subuh bagi meraih keberkatan dari Allah SWT.(n)

programme.title: Assalamualaikum(L)
programme.desc: Sebuah program bual bicara yang membicarakan topik-topik terkini dan menampilkan tetamu-tetamu undangan dari pelbagai bidang secara santai dan bersahaja.(n)

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.(n)

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.(n)

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.(n)

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.(n)

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.(n)

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.(n)

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?(n)

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.(n)

programme.title: Salam Nusantara
programme.desc: Mengungkap lebih banyak khazanah negeri Sarawak yang masih belum lagi diketahui oleh khalayak awam khasnya tentang perkembangan tamadun masyarakat majmuk Sarawak termasuklah umat Islam di negeri ini.(n)

programme.title: Kubah Borneo
programme.desc: “Kubah Borneo” will bring viewers a closer look of mosques located at several districts in Borneo Island. The host will visit a mosque at a different location to learn and share the history of the mosque.(n)

programme.title: Agrotech Heroes
programme.desc: AGROTECH HEROES, aims to nurture future Sarawak farmers by involving six contestants in 13 challenges involving agriculture, technology, and entrepreneurship for the grand prize of RM10,000.(n)

programme.title: Borneo Tech Heroes
programme.desc: Explore Borneo's digital revolution in this documentary series, showcasing innovative tech, thriving startups, and how they're transforming communities and reshaping the island's socio-economic landscape in the 4.0 era.(n)

programme.title: Startup Sarawak
programme.desc: Startup Sarawak' brings together digital entrepreneurs and other stakeholders in promoting the development of digital startup companies and initiatives in positioning Sarawak as the preferred startup hub for technology and entrepreneurs development.(n)

programme.title: From Malaysia With Love
programme.desc: Tiga Pengacara, Chef Adu Amran, Fiza Frizzy dan Kelvin Yap akan menyelami dan merasai pengalaman kehidupan masyarakat lokal dari pelbagai etnik.(n)

programme.title: Guru Luar Biasa
programme.desc: Guru Luar Biasa ialah sebuah dokumentari bersiri 6 episod yang akan memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman guru-guru yang pernah berkhidmat di Sarawak.(n)

programme.title: (L) TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni.(n)

programme.title: Mars Met Venus (Part Cewe)
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.(n)

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zéphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.(n)

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya (Diana Danielle) membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya (Remy Ishak) kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.(n)

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai “pintu menuju surga” selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.(n)

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Cikgu Lutfi yang baru ditukarkan ke sekolah berusaha membantu Hadi dan adiknya yang kematian ibu, tetapi konflik timbul apabila ibu saudara mereka kembali dan menimbulkan masalah keluarga.(n)

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.(n)

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya (Diana Danielle) membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya (Remy Ishak) kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.(n)

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan “khidmat bunuh diri” dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau (LAB). Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya — namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.(n)

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.(n)

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.(n)

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.(n)

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan.(n)

programme.title: Rock Bro!
programme.desc: Kisah kumpulan rock Rimba Bara meneruskan perjuangan mereka dalam industri muzik, namun konflik muncul apabila Jijoe jatuh cinta kepada legenda rock Ella dan menyebabkan band itu retak serta menimbulkan cabaran baru dalam kerjaya dan persahabatan.(n)

programme.title: Mars Met Venus (Part Cowo)
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dari sudut pandang Kelvin, seorang lelaki yang cuba memahami pasangannya, Mila, menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka. Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.(n)

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai “pintu menuju surga” selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.(n)

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.(n)

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.(n)

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.(n)

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.(n)

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.(n)

programme.title: D'Academy 7 Mega Konser: Dangdut Manja
programme.desc: Konsert muzik istimewa yang menampilkan sisi manja dan ceria muzik dangdut. Dimeriahkan dengan persembahan alumni D'Academy 7 yang membawakan lagu-lagu popular dengan aksi pentas yang menghiburkan, penuh gelagat comel dan irama yang menceriakan.(n)

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.(n)

programme.title: D'Academy 7
programme.desc: D' Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai D'Academy musim ketujuh?(n)

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.(n)

programme.title: Bulan Terbelah di Hati Mas Silver
programme.desc: Fikri, seorang lelaki tampan dan sederhana yang sedang mencari pekerjaan. Suatu hari, dia ditawarkan oleh rakannya untuk berkerja sebagai manusia silver. Walaupun pada awalnya, dia ragu, Fikri akhirnya menerima tawaran tersebut kerana memerlukan duit. Namun, pada waktu pertama kali bekerja, Fikri telah tertangkap dan berkenalan dengan Bulan, seorang komandan Satpoll PP yang cantik namun tegas. Meskipun pekerjaan mereka sangat berbeza, benih cinta mulai tumbuh antara mereka.(n)

programme.desc: Superstar Junior Indonesia ialah pertandingan bakat kanak-kanak yang disiarkan di Mentari TV. Rancangan ini menampilkan peserta cilik dari seluruh negara yang menunjukkan bakat dalam nyanyian, tarian dan lakonan untuk memikat hati juri dan penonton.(n)

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG (Kwok Chun On) saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAM's (Wu Fung) business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG (Pat Poon). Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONG's son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU (Chow Lai Ki, Niki), with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT (Frankie Lam), faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry…….(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded & What's On Today
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentina's World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. Explore the Amazon rainforest, the world's largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders' lives.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.(n)

programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.(n)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry…….(n)

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. programme.title: Severe Case Decoded & What's On Today
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentina's World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. Explore the Amazon rainforest, the world's largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders' lives.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: From "Hopscotch" to "Hands Up," TVB's children's programs have accompanied children's growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran children's program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment "Soaring Through the Air" holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun.(n)

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.(n)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG (Raymond Wong) and LAW KWAI-SZE (Grace Chan) want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK (Lau Kong), who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUK's concubines SUNG MING-FUNG (Louisa So) and KOO MAN-YEE (Rebecca Zhu), and maid TIN CHOR-YAT (Katy Kung) eventually can't take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN (Louis Yuen) bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls' cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women…….(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK$25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes… Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!(n)

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4.".(n)

programme.title: Once A Thief
programme.desc: Put Chai Ko (Chow Yun-fat), Jim (Leslie Cheung), and Red Bean (Cherie Chung) are all orphans who become international thieves under the tutelage of their adoptive father (Kenneth Tsang). By chance, Put Chai Ko, Jim, and Red Bean learn the whereabouts of a stolen masterpiece, "The Maid of Herring," from a Paris museum. Put Chai Ko, determined to complete his mission and retire to marry his girlfriend Red Bean, perishes in a fire during a mission. Years later, Red Bean marries Jim, who has always secretly loved her. Just when she thinks she can finally live a peaceful life, Put Chai Ko suddenly reappears, revealing that there's more to the story...(n)

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces.".(n)

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.(n)

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.(n)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the 'King of Ghosts' Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of 'Spirit Connection,' with the team closely following live broadcasts,.(n)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?(n)

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.(n)

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.(n)

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.(n)

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.(n)
